original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹耶伊发生三起独立事件致三人死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹耶伊河县警方称，上周末发生三起独立事件，共造成三人死亡，包括两起疑似自杀案件和一起雷击事件。一名11岁女孩在做饭时遭雷击身亡，其父亲据称随后在附近灌木丛中自缢。警方表示，耶伊地区疑似自杀案件自年初以来有所增加，原因包括经济困难、失业和药物滥用。

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹耶伊河县警方称上周末三起独立事件致三人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The police in Yei River County say three people died in separate incidents, including two suspected suicide cases and a lightning strike that killed an 11-year-old girl, over the weekend.

key_facts.fact: 一名男子据称在Mugwo警方羁押期间自缢身亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: one of the suspected suicide cases involved a man who allegedly hanged himself while in police custody in Mugwo

key_facts.fact: 一名11岁女孩Gloria Aputu在做饭时遭雷击身亡，其父亲随后自缢
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: an 11-year-old girl named Gloria Aputu was struck dead by lightning while cooking. Her father, Moses Batali, then ran to the bush and hanged himself

key_facts.fact: 警方称耶伊地区疑似自杀案件自年初以来有所增加
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Authorities say suspected suicide cases have increased in Yei since the beginning of the year due to economic hardships, unemployment, and drug abuse

uncertainties: 两起自杀案件为疑似（suspected），尚未获确认
事件信息目前仅来自单一来源（Radio Tamazuj）
